commonRules.failClosed: Missing, stale, contradictory, unknown, or unbound required state fails the applicable candidate gate.
commonRules.history: Active interests, invitations, threads, agreements, and duplicate-current pairs block a new product pair. Terminal history does not block by itself but must be captured for research interference.
commonRules.collation: Cause and contract compatibility is database-authoritative. Application code must not reproduce unfrozen PostgreSQL ILIKE Unicode behavior.
commonRules.transaction: Every mutation must invoke and revalidate the common authority immediately before mutation in the same PostgreSQL transaction snapshot.
commonRules.structuredSafety: Current structured moderation, noncompensable harm or threat, validity, baseline, legality, and participant-policy state is required; free text is never clearance.
commonRules.feed: Mechanism authorities emit unified envelopes. Cross-mechanism ranking may order eligible envelopes but cannot create, widen, or override eligibility.
commonRules.paidAction: Allocation identifiers are unique, integer minor units sum exactly, nested destination types follow the destination matrix, and system money legs never count as substantive consideration.
commonRules.nested: Each nested opportunity has a unique identifier, depth exactly one, the evaluated root opportunity as parent, an acyclic nested ancestry graph, current frozen terms, and an eligible authority result from the same snapshot.
commonRules.coAct: Direct Feed presentation carries no nested role or promised state; a nested Co-Act obligation binds exactly one role and the promised state fixed by its typed obligation level.
commonRules.consent: Product discovery, invitation delivery and acceptance, and research consent or waiver are separate typed states.
commonRules.research: recommendation_graph_edges is never matchability authority and no participant-level causal or expected-additional output is permitted.

intents.lifecycleRequirements: The mechanism authority must attest a current, eligible opportunity and freeze terms version, terms hash, source revision, effective time, and authority snapshot in the envelope.
intents.compatibilitySemantics: Delegated to the named mechanism authority; the Feed does not run reciprocal-cause logic for independent mechanisms.
intents.financialAttachmentCompatibility: Delegated to the mechanism authority. Paid Action destinations remain ontology-only and disabled for live activation.
intents.identityRequirements: Viewer authorization and source privacy must permit delivery; a mechanism envelope must not expose a private source-bound delivery as public inventory.
intents.blockAndRestrictionRules: The envelope must reflect the mechanism authority's current block and restriction decision. Ranking cannot override a failed authority.
intents.engagementRules: Mechanism-specific current engagement conflicts are resolved before envelope emission.
intents.structuredGateRules: Mechanism-specific structured gates must be current and cleared before envelope emission.
intents.productConsentAndPrivacyRules: Applicable product-discovery consent and delivery privacy are required. Invitation and research consent are not inferred.
intents.researchOnlyRules: None. Research-only envelopes cannot enter the product Feed.
intents.effectiveTimeAndSnapshot: One envelope binds one mechanism-authority snapshot; ranking is non-authoritative ordering over accepted envelopes.
intents.successOutput: One accepted unified opportunity envelope eligible only for cross-mechanism ordering.

intents.lifecycleRequirements: Source and target are distinct, current, published, open, operative, and revision-bound.
intents.compatibilitySemantics: reciprocal_pledge_swap requires a database-bound reciprocal-cause result; paid_action requires a database-bound typed action-and-consideration compatibility result.
intents.financialAttachmentCompatibility: Paid Action uses the nine-option destination schema and separate system money legs. No destination is live-enabled by this tranche.
intents.identityRequirements: Distinct offers and owners; actor is the source owner or another explicitly authorized role.
intents.blockAndRestrictionRules: Either-direction blocks and active or reviewing account, role, mechanism, or pair restrictions block.
intents.engagementRules: Active interest, invitation, thread, agreement, or duplicate-current pair blocks. Captured terminal history alone does not.
intents.structuredGateRules: Both offers and owners require current cleared structured states.
intents.productConsentAndPrivacyRules: Both sides require applicable product-discovery consent and compatible privacy scopes.
intents.effectiveTimeAndSnapshot: Read-only candidate decision under one frozen snapshot. The exact same common gates must make start_suggested_match actionable if state does not change.
intents.successOutput: A candidate pair that is semantically actionable by start_suggested_match under the same state.

intents.lifecycleRequirements: Same as reciprocal_trade_match_suggestion_list at mutation time.
intents.compatibilitySemantics: Same database-authoritative compatibility result as the suggestion intent, recomputed or re-read inside the mutation transaction.
intents.financialAttachmentCompatibility: Typed Paid Action consideration and nested authorities must still pass; every live payment destination remains disabled.
intents.identityRequirements: Authorized source owner, distinct target owner, and exact source and target identifiers.
intents.blockAndRestrictionRules: Re-evaluate all either-direction blocks and active restrictions after pair lock and immediately before mutation.
intents.engagementRules: Re-evaluate active interests, invitations, threads, agreements, and duplicate-current pair state. A blocked or other non-closed thread cannot be reused.
intents.structuredGateRules: Both offers and owners require current cleared states in the mutation snapshot.
intents.productConsentAndPrivacyRules: Both sides require product-discovery permission and compatible privacy. Invitation acceptance remains a separate later transition unless frozen terms explicitly require prior acceptance.
intents.effectiveTimeAndSnapshot: Pair lock, authority decision, and thread or proposal mutation share one PostgreSQL transaction snapshot; revision mismatch or concurrency fails closed.
intents.successOutput: Authority permission to perform only the named start-match mutation in the same transaction.

intents.lifecycleRequirements: The source is current, published, open, operative, and revision-bound. A supplied target offer must also be current.
intents.compatibilitySemantics: If an invitation is bound to a target offer, use the applicable database compatibility decision; otherwise bind the exact source terms and intended recipient channel.
intents.financialAttachmentCompatibility: The complete Paid Action schema is representable, but every destination is fail-closed for live enablement until separate payment, legal, and provider review.
intents.identityRequirements: Authorized source owner; no self-invitation; an account-bound recipient or explicitly first-claim private link contract.
intents.blockAndRestrictionRules: Known recipient pairs require either-direction block and active restriction checks. Unknown first-claim recipients must be rechecked atomically on claim and acceptance.
intents.engagementRules: An active invitation or other current pair engagement blocks duplicate creation where the recipient is known.
intents.structuredGateRules: Source structured gates are required at creation; recipient participant-policy gates are required when identity is known and again on acceptance.
intents.productConsentAndPrivacyRules: Invitation-delivery permission and invitation acceptance are separate. Creation may leave acceptance pending and creates no obligation; acceptance is required before an agreement transition.
intents.effectiveTimeAndSnapshot: Invitation insert and current-state revalidation share one transaction. Recipient claim and response repeat applicable gates in their own mutation transaction.
intents.successOutput: Authority permission to create one revocable, expiring invitation that creates no obligation.

intents.lifecycleRequirements: A current source draft is pending_review and paused from public inventory; approval may publish only the reviewed frozen revision.
intents.compatibilitySemantics: No pair compatibility decision is made at publication. Contract-family and nested terms must nevertheless be structurally valid.
intents.financialAttachmentCompatibility: Paid Action ontology may be reviewed in shadow, but no destination becomes live-enabled and no payment authorization is created.
intents.identityRequirements: Authorized reviewer plus exact source owner and offer revision.
intents.blockAndRestrictionRules: Applicable owner, role, and mechanism restrictions block approval; pair rules are deferred until a counterparty exists.
intents.engagementRules: Duplicate active offer and immutable source-link constraints apply; no thread or agreement is created by review.
intents.structuredGateRules: Source moderation, noncompensable harm or threat, validity, baseline, legality, and participant-policy states must be current and cleared.
intents.productConsentAndPrivacyRules: Product publication consent and public privacy scope are required. Research consent is separate.
intents.effectiveTimeAndSnapshot: Authority revalidation and publication or review-state mutation share one transaction and exact terms revision.
intents.successOutput: Authority permission for only the named review transition in the same transaction.

intents.lifecycleRequirements: Derived source is pending_review and private; original target is current, published, open, operative, and at the exact bound terms version, hash, and source revision.
intents.compatibilitySemantics: The exact source relationship and mechanism-specific nested authorities replace public reciprocal listing semantics; this is not cross-mechanism Feed ingestion.
intents.financialAttachmentCompatibility: Paid Action remains shadow-only. No money leg may be authorized by private delivery.
intents.identityRequirements: Authorized reviewer, distinct creator and original owner, and exact source-bound counterparty.
intents.blockAndRestrictionRules: Either-direction block and all active restrictions are rechecked after pair lock.
intents.engagementRules: Active current pair conflicts block or require the exact idempotent delivery record; terminal history is retained.
intents.structuredGateRules: Derived and original offers and both participants require current cleared structured states.
intents.productConsentAndPrivacyRules: Exact source-bound private-delivery permission and compatible private scopes are required; public publication is forbidden.
intents.researchOnlyRules: Private delivery is not research inclusion.
intents.effectiveTimeAndSnapshot: Pair lock, exact source revision revalidation, authority decision, counterproposal insert, and derived-draft close share one transaction.
intents.successOutput: Authority permission for one idempotent private delivery to the exact source counterparty.

intents.lifecycleRequirements: A product-authority candidate pair is projected without changing product state; current exclusion and terminal historical interference remain distinct.
intents.compatibilitySemantics: Consumes the database-authoritative product compatibility result. recommendation_graph_edges cannot supply or replace it.
intents.financialAttachmentCompatibility: Preserves typed Paid Action and settlement state only as approved research fields; it never authorizes payment.
intents.identityRequirements: Synthetic-only in this package. Protected identities or rows are prohibited.
intents.blockAndRestrictionRules: Current blocks and restrictions exclude the edge; captured terminal history remains an interference attribute.
intents.engagementRules: Current engagement conflicts exclude the edge. Terminal historical states are retained and never silently converted to zero.
intents.structuredGateRules: All applicable product structured gates remain required before research-only additions.
intents.productConsentAndPrivacyRules: Product consent is not research consent. Separate study-specific consent or an independently approved waiver or alteration is required.
intents.researchOnlyRules: Bound research purpose, privacy and ethics determinations, no recommendation-edge authority, no assignment entropy, and no participant causal output.
intents.effectiveTimeAndSnapshot: Read-only projection from one frozen authority snapshot; no product mutation or study execution.
intents.successOutput: A synthetic shadow edge decision only; never registration, assignment, contact, or causal attribution.
